slot_note: Superseded v1, v2 and v3 builds sit in a hidden .superseded_builds.tar.gz at the folder root (lineage only).
niche: seller onboarding slate for a live-inventory programme (Managed Availability) on a B2B industrial-parts exchange, priced from a staggered trial
answer: Onboard these eight sellers in the Q1 round and commit 182 incremental fulfilled orders for 2026Q2, the quarter the cohort goes live: Boquillas Bearing & Drive, Tallapoosa Supply Company, Piedmont Parts & Controls, Tensas Bearing & Drive, Shenandoah Electrical Supply, Yazoo Electrical Supply, Yampa Industrial Group and Housatonic Fluid Power.
stakeholder_role: runs seller operations at an industrial-parts exchange

spine.entity: one row is one order line placed by a buyer site against a seller listing, FULFILLED or CANCELLED
spine.grain: order line (buyer site x seller x part x timestamp), two trading years of 211,244 and 222,303 rows

world.geography: United States (regional seller naming, fictional exchange)

driver: The committed figure is the value of a capped set whose members' contributions overlap, so the value-maximising set is not the top-k by standalone value and summing standalone values overstates it, priced at a rate a staggered trial pins for the tenure stage the forward window falls in.
driver_concrete: Stockout events tried at more than one candidate's listings convert once, so the 8-of-20 slate maximises distinct 2025Q2 events (741, Lodgepole out and Housatonic in) and is priced at the first-live-quarter rate 0.246 the three trial waves identify, committing 182 orders.
stump: A solver who builds the charter's stockout events, carries the close-out summary's pooled 0.409 rate and sums the top eight sellers' own 2025Q2 events files 349 orders on a slate that keeps Lodgepole (R2, +92 per cent); finding the 0.246 tenure rate but still summing gives 210 (R3).

lineage.fate: superseded the same day 2026-09-05, folder empty; mechanism recorded as spent in ledger row '69 (PA draw, SUPERSEDED)'
lineage.driver: Each candidate's certified effect is its effect under the baseline configuration, and a concurrently randomized second change inflated some pooled effects through an interaction no balance check sees, so effects must be rebuilt in the joint assignment cells.

lineage.fate: built 2026-09-05; two responses landed the golden EXTEND +5.5 pp with the full construction (at ceiling by its own stopping rule); re-rooted 2026-09-06
lineage.driver: The causal quantity is a within-site contrast recovered by reconstructing assignment at intake behind a roster join, because the site-level movement is diluted by the routed share and the service-log contrast is survivor-conditioned by definition.

lineage.architecture: v2 (Demographic & Social Science re-root, period-varying assignment rate)
lineage.fate: failed its determinism review 2026-09-06 on Gate G single_conceptual_flip (answer CONTINUE, +2.9 pp)
lineage.driver: A case-blind designed test whose assignment rate varied across the periods the outcome moved over, so the year-long arm contrast is biased and the effect must be estimated within periods and re-pooled on the filed weights.

lineage.architecture: v3 (Product Analytics marketplace, first draw of this world)
lineage.fate: failed its determinism review 2026-09-06 on Gates B, C and G (single_conceptual_flip): constructs lived only in the write-up and a 55 per cent Q1 scaling contradicted the data (answer 169 orders)
lineage.driver: A forward commitment sized by how much of a trial effect a count cap can buy, where the decisive move swaps the counting basis from exception records to underlying demand events, the basis under which the trial's per-unit effect is homogeneous.

notes: D&SS was v1 and v2 (tarball); the build on disk is Product Analytics. Generators mapped from the design note (names no G-code). Subdomain, marketplace supply and seller operations, is outside the vocab. Executed-pilot calibration is one build from spent in Experiment & Causal (task43, 44, 69).
